synthetic_disclaimer: All identifiers, dates, and clinical details are fictional. Constructed for hackathon demo purposes; not based on any real patient.
demographics: 68F, never smoker, ECOG 1 (declined from 0 over the last 6 weeks). PMHx: T2DM (well-controlled, A1c 6.8), prior PE 2022 on apixaban, osteopenia. No prior radiation. Husband and adult daughter at most visits. Patient lives independently, drives.
diagnosis: Non-small cell lung cancer, adenocarcinoma. Initial stage IIIB (cT3 N2 M0) by AJCC 8th edition, diagnosed Sept 2024 after workup for persistent cough. Current status: stage IV — progression with new hepatic and osseous metastases on imaging April 2026.
pathology: RUL CT-guided biopsy, Sept 2024: Invasive adenocarcinoma, acinar predominant. Tumor cells positive for TTF-1, napsin-A. Negative for p40, ALK (D5F3), ROS1 (D4D6). Liver re-biopsy (segment VII), April 2026: Metastatic adenocarcinoma morphologically and immunohistochemically consistent with lung primary. TTF-1 retained.
molecular: Initial NGS, primary tumor (Sept 2024): EGFR exon 21 L858R mutation. TP53 missense mutation. PD-L1 TPS 5%. No co-occurring KRAS, ALK, ROS1, BRAF, MET, RET, HER2, NTRK alterations. TMB 4 mut/Mb. Repeat liquid biopsy (April 2026): EGFR L858R persistent. EGFR T790M not detected. NEW MET amplification, copy number 8.2. TP53 persistent. No new actionable alterations.
imaging: CT chest/abdomen/pelvis (April 20, 2026): Compared to Jan 18, 2026. Increase in RUL primary mass from 2.8 cm to 3.6 cm. New 1.4 cm and 0.9 cm hepatic lesions in segments VII and IVa, both with peripheral enhancement. New focal increased density at T8 vertebral body suggestive of osseous metastasis. Stable mediastinal lymph nodes. New small right pleural effusion. Brain MRI with contrast (April 21, 2026): No intracranial metastases. No leptomeningeal enhancement.

clinical_question: Next-line systemic therapy for EGFR L858R NSCLC progressing on osimertinib with newly detected MET amplification on liquid biopsy. Specifically: (1) role of osimertinib + MET inhibitor combination versus platinum-based chemotherapy with or without immunotherapy, (2) value of repeat tissue biopsy to confirm MET amplification and rule out additional resistance mechanisms, (3) timing and field for palliative radiation to T8 given pain trajectory, (4) eligibility for active combination trials in this setting.
